resources.string: Choose TV passthrough if your soundbar shows plain DTS or plays nothing on DTS-HD or DTS:X films.
Formats your receiver refused to open are no longer sent to it as passthrough. This lets them be tried again.
Tunnel off for: %1$s. Lets the next video try tunnelling again.
Off decodes AC-3 to PCM in the app. Turn off only if your receiver or TV cannot decode AC-3.
Off decodes DTS to PCM. Turn off if your receiver or TV cannot decode DTS - some TVs no longer license it.
Covers DTS-HD MA, HRA and DTS:X. Off decodes to PCM and loses DTS:X. Turn off if your receiver handles DTS but not DTS-HD.
Covers DD+ and DD+ Atmos. Off decodes to PCM. Turn off only if your receiver cannot decode Dolby Digital Plus.
Covers TrueHD and TrueHD Atmos. Off decodes to PCM and loses Atmos. Turn off only if your receiver cannot decode TrueHD.
Two channels. For TVs, stereo amplifiers and 2.0 soundbars.
Full surround with subwoofer. For 5.1 receivers and soundbars.
Full surround with rear channels and subwoofer. For 7.1 receivers.
Uses the channel count your audio system reports (2.0, 5.1 or 7.1).
Channel layout for audio the app decodes. Auto follows what your audio system reports; choose a layout when that report is wrong or leaves out a subwoofer.
Choose how surround formats are sent to your audio system.
Passes through the formats your audio system reports it can decode, and decodes the rest in the app.
Choose per format whether your audio system can decode it. Use this when the automatic report is wrong.
Test IEC 61937 output again. Use this if lossless formats fall back to PCM after changing receiver or input.
Re-encodes formats switched off above to Dolby Digital 5.1 instead of PCM. For receivers limited to 2-channel PCM; leave off if yours takes multichannel PCM.
Sound goes through the TV to a soundbar (ARC)
Auto converts formats the soundbar cannot take to Dolby Digital 5.1 and sends other decoded sound as stereo. Dolby Digital and Dolby Digital Plus pass through untouched.
Not available while Decoder priority is set to Prefer app decoders
Sends TrueHD and DTS-HD to your receiver through Android (System path) instead of Nuvio Arc (IEC path). Use this if lossless formats produce noise, drift, or no audio.
